title: builder subagents burn context on waits and whole-file reads
detail: pinned-engine solo builder: 86 tool turns at ~139K context each = 11.9M processed tokens (peak context only ~190K). Several turns were the agent being woken while waiting on its own background test runs, each re-reading the full context to do nothing; it also read very large modules whole (gate.py >4000 lines). Builder guidance should run bounded verifications in the foreground, read slices (grep then offset/limit), and batch independent calls.
